captures.description: "PROVENANCE ALIGNMENT": quoted, the AI Overview leads with #95's sense — 'visible, auditable, claim-level connections between AI-generated outputs and the original human-authored sources', alignment extended to 'the broader lifecycle of human knowledge production', three levels of attribution — and keeps apart the 2020 ACM sense of aligning reproduced executions; #95's author is not named.

atoms.evidence: Provenance alignment is a concept in artificial intelligence and data systems
refers to preserving visible, auditable, claim-level connections between AI-generated outputs and the original human-authored sources that support them
It extends traditional AI alignment (like value alignment or safety) beyond single-model behavior

Provenance alignment is a concept in artificial intelligence and data systems that refers to preserving visible, auditable, claim-level connections between AI-generated outputs and the original human-authored sources that support them.
